youtube_quota_note: quota.py keeps optional extras (comments, playlists, title swaps, replies, angle searches) inside the daily YouTube allowance so uploads always fit; set youtube_upload_units to what the Google Cloud console shows for an upload.
languages_note: The Spanish channel is dropped (Charlie, 21 October). Language channels (Charlie, 19 October): Chatterbox Multilingual's own voice (he picked default over George and Emma); each channel's YouTube sign-in is tokens/youtube_<lang>.enc, made with the social workflow (channel es or pt).
approval_note: all: every Short waits for Charlie's OK; flagged: only Shorts with a reason to look wait (the end goal); none: everything uploads straight away.
note: Three writer runs a day (see runs): 20:50 writes the first part of tomorrow, 06:50 and 12:50 write from the day's trends. daily_limit is Shorts made per day, slots_per_day how many go public a day (all 24 hours from 07:30, every 36 minutes, until learned slots take over), upload_limit_24h how many uploads GitHub attempts in 24 hours. The channel has YouTube's Advanced features; if YouTube refuses an upload for its limit, the Short waits and the next run retries. The YouTube Data API allows about 100 uploads a day.

background.note: Pexels is off (Charlie, 21 October: Pexels issues no new API keys); Pixabay (free key, in place) and NASA carry the video behind every Short.

background_note: The video behind every Short (pipeline/background.py), 19 October. A board lists 2 to 4 stock searches in "background"; plan.py picks one clip per search (Pexels first, then Pixabay, NASA for a nasa: search; never a clip used in the last reuse_days days), render3 blurs (blur) and darkens (target_luma is the average brightness 0 to 1; a clip darker than min_luma is refused, a dim one is lifted at most max_gain times; brightness above knee, 0 to 255, is squeezed so bright spots never wash out the captions), cross-fades (fade seconds) and plays them under everything, about 8 to 15 seconds each (clip_seconds). Photos then sit on top as cards; real video of the subject still plays full screen. enabled true (since the 19 October test renders): every Short gets it unless its board says "bgvideo": false; with false, only boards with "bgvideo": true do (test boards). Needs the PEXELS_API_KEY and PIXABAY_API_KEY secrets; with neither, or no clip found, a Short renders the old full-screen way.
tiktok_note: off (Charlie, 19 Oct 2026): TikTok blocked every post as spam and its Creator Rewards only pay for videos over a minute, so nothing goes there. inbox: the day's 5 TikTok picks land in the TikTok phone app as drafts once scheduled, and Charlie posts them with the captions from his TikTok queue page; manual: he uploads them himself; direct: posts by itself (needs TikTok's review).
instagram_note: all: every Short goes to Instagram once public on YouTube, the day's picks first, at most a ramped number in 24 hours: instagram_per_day to start, +instagram_ramp_per_day for each day since the first Reel, up to instagram_target (Meta allows 100 API posts a day; it blocked our API access once, so the ramp is gentle). Shorts public for more than crosspost_max_age_hours are skipped. picks: only the day's picks.
breakout_note: A Short at breakout_times or more the views recent Shorts had at the same age (and at least breakout_min_views) is a breakout: the next run writes a follow-up, from a fresh pack on the subject or from the Short's own pages.
factpack_note: trends.yml builds trends/facts.json after trends.py: Gemini (GEMINI_API_KEY) lists each top topic's facts with the exact sentences, and a fact counts as verified only when those sentences are found word for word in two of the day's reputable pages and its numbers match.
reserve_note: Evergreen Shorts in boards/reserve fill any of the day's slots the writer runs left empty: after reserve_after (UK), up to reserve_per_day a day. In flagged approval mode a reserve Short with nothing flagged needs no approval; a flagged one waits for a 'reserve approve' line.
upload_limit_note: The ceiling learns (quota.py, status/upload_limit.json): from daily_limit it rises by upload_limit_step after each filled day YouTube accepted everything (no refusal in 48 hours), up to upload_limit_max (72 x 100 units leaves the API allowance room for the extras), and settles where YouTube first refuses (uploadLimitExceeded). The writer's runs, the slots and the hourly uploads all follow it; each change is a line in analytics/decisions.csv.
models_note: Writer models (pipeline/factpack.py writing_order): a Short is written best writer first: the strongest keyed free models (GROQ_API_KEY, CEREBRAS_API_KEY, MISTRAL_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY secrets; big chat models such as Kimi K2 or GPT-OSS 120B; 'providers' here can pin model lists), Gemini Flash (240 s), Gemma, weaker keyed models, then only when all else failed Gemini Lite, the open model on the runner (local_model) and Claude. Claude (CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, claude_model, claude_max_per_run calls a run) also edits passing boards (title, comment, first and last lines; claude_edits_per_day) and writes 1 board in 4 as a test arm (claude_writes_per_day), counted per UK day in status/claude_usage.json. analytics/models.json scores writers, editors and pairs; the writer picks from that and Claude's shares fall back when its Shorts earn no more views.
runs_note: Shorts each writer run makes. evening (20:50) writes the first part of TOMORROW (created = tomorrow, slots from 07:30) so flagged ones can be approved before bed; morning (06:50) and afternoon (12:50) write from that day's fresh trends.
crosspost_youtube_line: New every day on YouTube: Quickplay Daily
facebook_note: Facebook Page Reels (GitHub secrets FB_PAGE_TOKEN and FB_PAGE_ID): every Short once public on YouTube, picks first, ramped like Instagram (Meta allows 30 API Reels per Page per 24 hours).

accounts.note: The identity guard (pipeline/identity.py, audit.yml): everything the automation signs in to must be the studio Google account or an account hanging off it, all named Quickplay. The audit checks every sign-in live; a mismatch opens a security issue and stops every posting workflow (identity.py gate).
accounts.secrets_note: Every secret a workflow may read. A new one is added here on purpose, by hand; the audit flags any other.
